$comment: Design tokens for the Afloy Lora Box node. Single source of truth, kept in sync with the :root{--lb-*} block in web/lora_box.js and the 'LoraBox' variable collection in the Figma file dV1Uq5NNfVYkqI7fMs6MUY. The four 'active' tokens are wired into the CSS as var(--lb-*); the rest document the full mockup palette for reference / future tokenisation.

accent.use: primary blue: switch on, slider fill, focus rings, links

accent-soft.use: active-count badge, selected picker row, menu hover background

field.use: inset fields: weight value box, search box, trigger textarea
